note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because the datasets-server infers `meta` as `struct<factory, generator, round>` from the early shards and then cannot cast the 10 dest-stamped records in `batch-r1459.jsonl`-`batch-r1463.jsonl` whose `meta` also carries `designed` / `kind` / `domain` / `seed` / `stack`, while `reward` is a three-way key-bag and the top-level `state` object is absent from 3038 of 3518 records; declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present and non-empty on all 3518 records; unlike `long-horizon-coding-trajectories` this column is not optional here

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; 7 distinct key sets across the 59188 steps, one per tool shape

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 7181 of 59188 steps; always a string where present

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool), `cost_steps`, `plan_changes`, `tests_passed` (int) on every record, plus `handoff` and `xfailed` (int) co-present on 580, and `retries` (int) on 5

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator` (string) and `round` (int) on every record, plus `designed` (bool), `kind`, `domain`, `seed`, `stack` (string) on the 10 dest-stamped records

features.name: state
features.note: present on 480 of 3518 records, all `azr-*`; both keys are present on all 480 and both values are constant, so it is declared as a struct rather than as `json`

struct.name: sim_or_real
struct.note: the literal string `designed` on all 480 records that carry `state`

struct.name: domain
struct.note: the literal string `authz-regression` on all 480 records that carry `state`

disclosures.summary: Ten dest-stamped leftover-mill records keep `meta.factory=authz-regression-factory` but are search-index rebuild episodes (`id` prefix `sir-*`), not authorization episodes. They sit two per shard in `batch-r1459.jsonl` through `batch-r1463.jsonl` and are the only records whose `meta` carries `designed` / `kind` / `domain` / `seed` / `stack`, so they are exactly the rows the inferred `struct<factory, generator, round>` cast dies on. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: On those 10 records `meta.kind` is the literal string `episode`, `meta.designed` is `true`, and `meta.seed` is a slug string equal to `meta.domain` rather than a numeric seed. No record in this dataset carries a top-level `kind`.

`reward` is a three-way key-bag, not a fixed struct: 2933 records carry `{cost_steps, plan_changes, success, tests_passed}`, 580 add `handoff` and `xfailed` (both always the integer 1, never co-absent), and 5 add `retries` (always the integer 2). The `handoff` / `xfailed` pair is an exact complement of the success flag: all 580 records that carry it have `reward.success=false` and all 2938 that do not have `reward.success=true`. It is not a leftover-mill marker: 575 of those 580 are ordinary `azr-*` authorization episodes.

`retries` is the one reward key confined to the dest-stamped leftovers: the 5 records that carry it are exactly the 5 `sir-*-rebuild` rows of rounds 1459-1463. Their 5 `sir-*-handoff` siblings carry `handoff` / `xfailed` instead, so no dest-stamped record has the base reward key set.

The optional top-level `state` object is a constant round-level marker rather than per-record data: it is `{"sim_or_real": "designed", "domain": "authz-regression"}` on every one of the 480 records that carry it, and it is emitted for both records of a round or for neither. It covers 240 whole rounds in two contiguous blocks, 1435-1458 and 1544-1759; the 85-round gap between them opens at round 1459, the first round of the dest-stamped leftover mill. All 480 are `azr-*` records.

All 3518 records are stamped `meta.factory=authz-regression-factory` and `meta.generator=grok-4.6`. 3508 are authorization IDOR / BFLA leftover-mechanic episodes (`id` prefix `azr-*`); the same-factory leftover phrasing on those rows is the advertised mechanic, not a foreign dump. The payload spans 1759 shards with no gaps: rounds 1 through 1759, exactly two records per round, and `meta.round` always matches the shard filename.

Every one of the 59188 steps publishes a public `decision_basis` alongside its `tool_call` and `observation`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields. `reflection` is the only optional step key: it is present on 7016 of the 59023 `azr-*` steps and on all 165 steps of the 10 dest-stamped `sir-*` records.
